set.description: Answer-keyed teaching cases built by the mutation engine from seeded Solar prime bases: causal fraud pairs, near-threshold, conflicting-signal and thin-evidence cases. Each case carries the teaching answer (expected) and the engine's answer (system: the credit policy, with the underwriting policy and the reference label as separate columns). The gate checks system as a regression; expected-versus-system gaps are listed with reasons.
set.base_rule: Clean case approved by the credit policy (no flags) and the underwriting policy, no fraud alert, claimed FICO ≥ 680, claimed DTI ≤ 30%, claimed checking ≥ $1,000, all six evidence documents present.

difficulty_rule.easy: One deciding signal at least twice its rule's threshold, or a clean case with margin.
difficulty_rule.medium: One deciding signal within 10% above its rule's threshold, or a case one step either side of a policy threshold (FICO ±1 point, DTI ±0.1 points, checking at $999 or $1,000).
difficulty_rule.hard: Two interacting signals, or a missing document.

rubric.pairClean: Claims, truth and evidence agree and every policy threshold is met with margin: approve.
rubric.pairFraud: The claims alone would pass, but one verified fact contradicts them: refer for verification (review), not approve.
rubric.fico: Claimed FICO below 660 declines; 660 and above passes.
rubric.dti: DTI above 45% declines; from 36% to 45% goes to review; below 36% passes.
rubric.liquidity: At DTI above 40%, checking under $1,000 adds a liquidity flag; the elevated DTI already means review.
rubric.conflictMaterial: Income overstated and debt understated, each above its HIGH threshold: refer for verification.
rubric.conflictSubThreshold: Income overstated and debt understated, each below its HIGH threshold: together the claims cannot be relied on, so re-underwrite on verified figures (review).
rubric.thin: A required document is missing: the case cannot be decided on the evidence, so review.
